title: Patient Care Desk Training: Adherence Credit at a Manufacturer Copay Card Period Opening (Savings & Copay Assistance Programs)
content:
An adherence credit is added to the opening credit of a Manufacturer Copay Card benefit period of the Savings & Copay Assistance Programs. It follows the benefit entries on the program dated fewer than 12 whole months before today: **8 or more** add **600.00 dollars**, **4 to 7** add **300.00 dollars**, and fewer add nothing.

**Which entries count?** The benefit entries on the card's activity dated fewer than 12 whole months before today.

**What are the band edges?**

| Benefit entries in the window | Adherence credit added |
|---|---|
| 3 | $0.00 |
| 4 | $300.00 |
| 7 | $300.00 |
| 8 | $600.00 |

**Hypothetical:** a card with 7 benefit entries in the window adds $300.00; one more entry in the window would add $600.00.
